lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Where to Find Communication Impediment on License
prompt: How does having the notation on the physical license assist the driver when handed to an officer?

options.text: The officer is legally forced to dismiss all pending traffic moving citations
The officer immediately sees the indicator and adapts communication style safely
The driver is granted immediate diplomatic immunity from all county court fines
The officer must contact the Governor's office before completing traffic stop
